prompts.lightning: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Rasta Quest separate lightning_proc effect authoring sheet. Create a transparent wide image with THREE consecutive equal cells of the SAME contained cyan/blue lightning burst. No character, no weapon, no lettering. Premium crisp pixel art, strong intentional pixel clusters, readable at 48 to 64 source pixels, NOT blurry airbrush. Key1 a thin jagged cyan arc seed near center; key2 branching controlled discharge with a bright white/cyan small core and two readable zigzag forks; key3 sparse fading blue/cyan fragments and one short branch. Keep all effects in a compact centered circular envelope, same center and fixed drawing density, no growing explosion ball, no radial sun, no religious symbols/runes, no purple/red/yellow fire, no background/ground/shadow. Clear transparent gutters between cells. Solid opaque colored pixel clusters and genuinely transparent background; no bloom, no smoke or gradient haze. Restrained flash area for mobile legibility. A coherent 3-key effect progression.
prompts.portal: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Rasta Quest separate portal interaction effect authoring sheet, not protagonist body clip. Transparent landscape 2x2 four equal cells showing the SAME vertical elliptical fantasy portal rim activating. No character, no weapon, no scenery. Same ellipse size and center in every cell, width about 60 percent of height; premium crisp pixel-art clusters, readable in small mobile gameplay. Key1 several separated dark teal/cyan rim fragments around an empty transparent oval; key2 a connected thin cyan broken-energy ring, hollow center fully transparent; key3 a brighter cyan/white pulsing rim with just a few tiny angular sparks; key4 rim contracts in intensity by losing segments, same physical ellipse radius, hollow center. Controlled blue/cyan/teal/white family only, no magenta or fire, no religious markings, text, runes, icons, stars or gate architecture. Equal isolated cells and generous transparent gutters. Fixed rim shape and exact same drawing scale, no perspective or tilt drift; no soft glow/haze/bloom, no cast shadow or background. Actual alpha transparency inside AND outside the ring. Four distinct crisp keys.
